en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:

id: \bGoh: Hey \PN. Could you meet me at Cerise Park? Thanks.
en: \bGoh: Hey \PN. Could you meet me at Cerise Park?  Thanks.
it: \bGoh: Ehi \PN. Puoi raggiungermi al Parco Cerise? Grazie.

id: \rMom: Welcome home \PN!
en: \rMom: Welcome home \PN!
it: \rMamma: Bentornato a casa, \PN!

id: \bGreat job at the league \PN!
en: \bGreat job at the league \PN!
it: \bOttimo lavoro alla Lega, \PN!

id: \bProfessor Oak focuses on Pokémon and human relationships in his research.
en: \bProfessor Oak focuses on Pokémon and human relationships in his research.
it: \bNelle sue ricerche il Professor Oak si concentra sul rapporto tra Pokémon ed esseri umani.

id: The door is locked.
en: The door is locked.
it: La porta è chiusa a chiave.

en: \rPidgey

en: \rPidgeotto
it: \rPidgeotto

id: \rPidgeot
en: \rPidgeot

id: \bFeeling slow? Press the 'F7' key.
en: \bFeeling slow? Press the 'F7' key.
it: \bTi senti lento? Premi il tasto 'F7'.

id: \PN's house
en: \PN's house
it: Casa di \PN

id: \rYou did wonderful.
en: \rYou did wonderful.
it: \rSei stato bravissimo.

id: They seem to be offering you a Pokémon. Would you like to take it?
en: They seem to be offering you a Pokémon. Would you like to take it?
it: Sembra che ti stiano offrendo un Pokémon. Vuoi prenderlo?

id: There is no room for it.
en: There is no room for it.
it: Non c'è spazio.

id: \bI locked myself out of the house again...
en: \bI locked myself out of the house again...
it: \bMi sono chiuso fuori casa un'altra volta...

id: \bI wish I was as strong as you.
en: \bI wish I was as strong as you.
it: \bVorrei essere forte come te.

id: Gary's house
en: Gary's house
it: Casa di Gary

id: \bYour dreams will burn to...
en: \bYour dreams will burn to...
it: \bI tuoi sogni bruceranno in...

id: \bYes, that has to be it. If I follow those instructions I'll find the ultimate challenge without a doubt. But what could the last word possibly be?
en: \bYes, that has to be it. If I follow those instructions I'll find the ultimate challenge without a doubt. But what could the last word possibly be?
it: \bSì, dev'essere così. Se seguo quelle istruzioni troverò senza dubbio la sfida definitiva. Ma quale potrà mai essere l'ultima parola?

id: \bYou can jump over this ledge by walking up to it.
en: \bYou can jump over this ledge by walking up to it.
it: \bPuoi saltare giù da questa sporgenza camminandoci contro.

id: There's a barrier in the way. You can't pass.
en: There's a barrier in the way. You can't pass.
it: C'è una barriera. Non puoi passare.

id: \bYou tried your best.
en: \bYou tried your best.
it: \bHai fatto del tuo meglio.

id: Pallet Town\nShades of your journey await!
en: Pallet Town\nShades of your journey await!
it: Biancavilla\nLe sfumature del tuo viaggio ti attendono!

id: \bGary: So \PN, you woke up late. What a loser. It's a shame, because I ended up getting the best Pokémon.
en: \bGary: So \PN, you woke up late. What a loser. It's a shame, because I ended up getting the best Pokémon.
it: \bGary: Allora, \PN, ti sei svegliato tardi. Che sfigato. Peccato, perché alla fine il Pokémon migliore me lo sono preso io.

id: \bIt's good to have a grandfather in the business, isn't it.\nCatch you later, \PN.
en: \bIt's good to have a grandfather in the business, isn't it.\nCatch you later, \PN.
it: \bÈ comodo avere un nonno del mestiere, eh?\nCi si vede, \PN.

id: \bGary: I heard you beat the Orange League and did something for my grandfather while I was gone.
en: \bGary: I heard you beat the Orange League and did something for my grandfather while I was gone.
it: \bGary: Ho sentito che hai vinto la Lega Orange e che hai fatto qualcosa per mio nonno mentre ero via.

id: \bI guess you're tough enough to have a battle with me.
en: \bI guess you're tough enough to have a battle with me.
it: \bImmagino che tu sia abbastanza forte da lottare con me.

id: \bGary: Not bad, \PN, though you still have a long way to go.
en: \bGary: Not bad, \PN, though you still have a long way to go.
it: \bGary: Niente male, \PN, anche se hai ancora molta strada da fare.

id: \bI'm off to challenge the Johto League. See ya.
en: \bI'm off to challenge the Johto League. See ya.
it: \bMe ne vado a sfidare la Lega di Johto. Ci vediamo.

id: \bGary: \PN, good to see you again. How has it been traveling the world?
en: \bGary: \PN, good to see you again. How has it been traveling the world?
it: \bGary: \PN, che piacere rivederti. Com'è andato il viaggio per il mondo?

id: \bI bet you've become a Pokémon Master by this point, haven't you?
en: \bI bet you've become a Pokémon Master by this point, haven't you?
it: \bScommetto che ormai sei diventato un Maestro di Pokémon, vero?

id: \bHm, I guess that's up for you to decide. I'll see you around. Later, \PN.
en: \bHm, I guess that's up for you to decide. I'll see you around. Later, \PN.
it: \bMah, immagino che stia a te deciderlo. Ci vediamo in giro. A presto, \PN.

id: \r\PN, you did great in the league. I'm so proud of you!
en: \r\PN, you did great in the league. I'm so proud of you!
it: \r\PN, sei stato fantastico alla Lega. Sono così fiera di te!

id: \bGary: I decided I'm done with Gym battles. I'm gonna head to Hoenn and help my grandfather with his research.
en: \bGary: I decided I'm done with Gym battles. I'm gonna head to Hoenn and help my grandfather with his research.
it: \bGary: Ho deciso di chiudere con le lotte in Palestra. Andrò a Hoenn ad aiutare mio nonno con le sue ricerche.

id: \bGary: Long time no see \PN.
en: \bGary: Long time no see \PN.
it: \bGary: Quanto tempo, \PN.

id: \bI just got back from the Sinnoh region. I've been doing some research there.
en: \bI just got back from the Sinnoh region. I've been doing some research there.
it: \bSono appena tornato dalla regione di Sinnoh. Ci ho fatto un po' di ricerca.

id: \bYou want to see one of the Pokémon I got from there?
en: \bYou want to see one of the Pokémon I got from there?
it: \bVuoi vedere uno dei Pokémon che ho preso laggiù?

id: \bGary: You've really gotten strong, though I still think I could beat you if I tried.
en: \bGary: You've really gotten strong, though I still think I could beat you if I tried.
it: \bGary: Sei diventato davvero forte, anche se credo che potrei ancora batterti, se mi impegnassi.

id: \bI'm heading back to Sinnoh soon. I suggest you visit it.
en: \bI'm heading back to Sinnoh soon. I suggest you visit it.
it: \bTornerò presto a Sinnoh. Ti consiglio di visitarla.

id: \rJigglypuff
en: \rJigglypuff
it: \rJigglypuff

id: \bGary: What are you doing here \PN? Shouldn't you be off becoming a Pokémon Master?
en: \bGary: What are you doing here \PN? Shouldn't you be off becoming a Pokémon Master?
it: \bGary: Che ci fai qui, \PN? Non dovresti essere in giro a diventare un Maestro di Pokémon?

id: \bI guess you wanted to come see your old pal. I can take a quick break to battle with you.
en: \bI guess you wanted to come see your old pal. I can take a quick break to battle with you.
it: \bImmagino che tu volessi venire a trovare il tuo vecchio amico. Posso prendermi una breve pausa per lottare con te.

id: \bGary: I should get back to work. Researching Pokémon is a never-ending pursuit.
en: \bGary: I should get back to work. Researching Pokémon is a never-ending pursuit.
it: \bGary: Dovrei tornare al lavoro. La ricerca sui Pokémon non finisce mai.

id: \rMom: How did it go, \PN? Ah, it looks like you got a lovely Pikachu.
en: \rMom: How did it go, \PN? Ah, it looks like you got a lovely Pikachu.
it: \rMamma: Com'è andata, \PN? Ah, sembra che tu abbia ricevuto un adorabile Pikachu.

id: \rIt's going to be a wonderful journey, I can just tell. You were in such a rush I didn't have time to give you these earlier. Be sure to use them.
en: \rIt's going to be a wonderful journey, I can just tell.  You were in such a rush I didn't have time to give you these earlier. Be sure to use them.
it: \rSarà un viaggio meraviglioso, me lo sento. Andavi così di fretta che prima non ho fatto in tempo a darti queste. Usale, mi raccomando.

id: \PN obtained Running Shoes.
en: \PN obtained Running Shoes.
it: \PN ha ottenuto le Scarpe da corsa.

id: \rMom: It's going to be a wonderful journey, I can just tell.
en: \rMom: It's going to be a wonderful journey, I can just tell.
it: \rMamma: Sarà un viaggio meraviglioso, me lo sento.

id: \rDon't leave. Wild Pokémon are out there.
en: \rDon't leave. Wild Pokémon are out there.
it: \rNon uscire. Là fuori ci sono Pokémon selvatici.

id: \rHi \Pn, how is it going?
en: \rHi \Pn, how is it going?
it: \rCiao \Pn, come va?

id: Professor Oak's Lab
en: Professor Oak's Lab
it: Laboratorio del Professor Oak

id: \bOak: \PN, great job in the league. Gary stopped by already and told us he lost. He left before I could ask him to do me a favor, so I'm wondering if you would.
en: \bOak: \PN, great job in the league. Gary stopped by already and told us he lost. He left before I could ask him to do me a favor, so I'm wondering if you would.
it: \bOak: \PN, ottimo lavoro alla Lega. Gary è già passato a dirci che ha perso. È andato via prima che potessi chiedergli un favore, quindi mi chiedevo se potessi farmelo tu.

id: \bWould you head to Valencia Island in the Orange Archipelago for me?
en: \bWould you head to Valencia Island in the Orange Archipelago for me?
it: \bAndresti all'Isola Valencia, nell'Arcipelago Orange, per conto mio?

id: \bProfessor Ivy is there and has a mysterious Poké Ball she wants me to check out. There is a league there as well that might interest you.
en: \bProfessor Ivy is there and has a mysterious Poké Ball she wants me to check out. There is a league there as well that might interest you.
it: \bLì c'è la Professoressa Ivy, che ha una misteriosa Poké Ball che vuole farmi esaminare. C'è anche una Lega che potrebbe interessarti.

id: \bHead up to Viridian City. There is a blimp that will take you.
en: \bHead up to Viridian City. There is a blimp that will take you.
it: \bVai a Smeraldopoli. C'è un dirigibile che ti porterà lì.

id: \bOak: Head up to Viridian City. There is a blimp that will take you to Valencia Island.
en: \bOak: Head up to Viridian City. There is a blimp that will take you to Valencia Island.
it: \bOak: Vai a Smeraldopoli. C'è un dirigibile che ti porterà all'Isola Valencia.
